scientific_integrity: All mathematical statements are proved by local Boolean identities, a constructive inverse for each admissible image and formal rational matrix calculations. Computations use standalone source files and recorded reproducible results. No independent mathematical audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Fixed labelled left-to-right in-place schedule, rings of length at least three and one sweep only. The image theorem is proved via explicit predecessor and a four-state automaton; finite replay corroborates it but is not the all-length proof. The novelty comparison covers inspected published records and accessible literature; inaccessible or unindexed historical sources may affect priority. The theorem does not establish multi-sweep attraction, arbitrary update schedules, or inverse-fiber distribution.
title: Exact one-sweep reachability and image entropy for asynchronous Rule 184
